    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) <= 2 and grid[r].count(common) > w // 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == common for r in range(h)) > h // 2]
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]

    # The intersections define the output lattice; strip its outermost border.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) or sum(v != grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) > 1]
